caption: The drawing features a horizontal decorative band located near the center of an otherwise blank, light beige or off-white background. The band is composed of a repeating pattern that includes stylized leaf-like shapes in varying shades of green, interspersed with clusters of circular shapes in dark brown or black. There are accents of dark red, forming geometric shapes that serve as a background for the green and brown elements. The band is bordered on the top and bottom edges with solid green and black lines, framing the pattern within the strip. The composition is symmetrical and regular, with the elements repeating along the length of the band. No other objects or designs are present on the page.
title: Wallpaper Border
